title: Tech Note: 4D on Docker
author: Ayoub Khali, Technical Services Engineer, 4D Inc.
featured_technology: VNC / X Server for GUI containers

historical_commentary.text: Docker containerization of 4D Server is still a fully valid and increasingly common deployment pattern today (especially for headless 4D Server in Linux containers), so the fundamental approach in this note remains relevant, though the specific Docker CLI/installation details have evolved somewhat since 2019.
related_updates: 4D Server on Linux (a later addition to 4D's platform support) has made Docker/container deployment of 4D Server considerably more natural than the Windows/macOS-guest-in-container approach implied here
Docker Desktop licensing and installation flows have changed since 2019, but core Docker concepts (images, containers, volumes, Dockerfile) are unchanged
